Are posts reviewed?

We plan to review content against our terms of use.

Are there courses in English?

We plan to start with English courses for visitors and expand to more languages with subtitles.

Are there selling fees?

We plan to charge a fee only when an item sells. The rate has not been decided.

Are there subtitles?

We plan to start with Japanese and English subtitles.

Can I book a tour from outside Japan?

Yes. The tours are designed for visitors to Japan, so we plan to support booking and guidance in English and other languages.

Can I buy from abroad?

We plan to start with sellers who ship internationally.

Can I download titles?

We are considering offline playback.

Can I join without speaking Japanese?

Yes. Tours are planned with guides in English and other languages. Each tour lists its languages.

Can I take my work home?

For pieces that need time to finish, such as fired pottery, we plan to ship them overseas once complete.

Can I teach?

We plan to open instructor sign-ups for artisans, researchers and creators at launch.

Can I use any services today?

Not yet. Jinsei Koubo is still at the concept stage. Sign up below to hear when services launch.

Can children join?

Age requirements will be set for each tour. Sake tastings are for ages 20 and over only.

Can people abroad watch?

Yes. We are exploring tools such as automatic subtitle translation.

Do I need a separate account for each service?

No. The plan is for one shared account to work across all seven services.

Do I need materials or tools?

Each course lists what you need in advance. We are also considering tool kits.

Do I need special equipment?

We plan for it to run in a computer or phone browser. VR headsets will not be required.

How much can I earn?

Revenue shares have not been decided and will be announced at launch.

How much does it cost?

The monthly price has not been decided and will be announced at launch.

If I put ¥10,000 into the research fund, will my money grow?

Not necessarily. Research can fail, and you may not get your money back. Rewards (progress reports, lab tours, financial returns and so on) will vary by project. Any financial returns will only start once the required legal framework is in place.

Is anything prohibited?

Rules on prohibited items, including those banned by law, will be set at launch.

Is there a fee?

Entry is planned to be free, with fees only for some paid events and digital items.

What can I do in this demo?

Walk your avatar through four areas, play the quiz in the Game Arena, and jump to each service.

What do I need to sell in the market?

We plan to let individuals sell with a shared account and identity verification. Rules on prohibited items will be announced at launch.

What research is eligible?

High-impact research such as next-generation energy, listed after review.

When does it start?

Only after the legal framework is in place. We are first considering a reward-based model.

Will my money grow?

Not necessarily. Research can fail, and you may not get your money back.
